request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. Senza misura, no fixed beat. Near-silence and spacious air-like acoustic resonance. One very distant innocent wordless treble voice only on D and B-flat; omit A, the pendulum has stopped. Extremely distant D2 bronze bell every 20 to 30 seconds, long decay. Organised silence should occupy most of the cue. Brief delicate echoes of celesta, harp and a muted horn, never all at once. White-gold vacuum before judgement. No percussion. Only wordless humming or vowel choir as specified; NO intelligible words, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
